_about: Sea-Tac (portseattle.org/sea/flight-status), every row it listed at about 2:45 PM PDT on 2026-10-12 for that day and the next, read page by page in its default city order, as workers/fids-proxy.js seaParsePage serves each row: [number, scheduled local (PDT), far-end IATA, far-end name, gate, status, revised local (PDT) or "", belt, record]. A few rows moved between pages while they were read and are missing, among them Delta's own rows of the 10-13 5:47 PM arrival from Paris and the 10-12 8:15 PM departure to Phoenix: groups without their operator, as a board can meet them.
